cast_dialogue.linea: How often does a hero train? Always? Sometimes? Let's measure the rhythm of your days.
I always play video games after school. I never do homework first!
I usually ride my bike to work, but I sometimes take the bus when it rains.
I often go swimming on Saturdays, and I rarely eat out on weekdays.
I always eat vegetables, and I never stay up late. That is the secret, children.

banco_oraciones.oracion: Kenji always plays video games after school.
Ben usually rides his bike to work.
Sofía often goes swimming on Saturdays.
They sometimes eat out on Fridays.
She doesn't usually eat fast food.
We rarely go shopping on Mondays.
Do you always do your homework?
How often does she go to the movies?
Do you often play soccer? Yes, I do.
Does she ever eat out? No, she doesn't.
Is Ben always on time? Yes, he is.

banner_diagnostico.opcion_a: She goes always swimming on Saturdays.
banner_diagnostico.opcion_b: She always goes swimming on Saturdays.

inicio.definicion_pragmatica: Adverbs of frequency say how often something happens. They go BEFORE the main verb but AFTER the verb 'to be': 'She always swims' but 'She is always happy'.

ejercicios.pregunta: He is ___ late. He arrives at nine every day. (100%)
They ___ eat fast food — only twice a year!

ejercicios.afirmacion: Adverbs of frequency go before the main verb.
With 'to be', the adverb goes before the verb: 'She always is happy'.

ejercicios.texto: I ___ do yoga in the morning. (every day, 100%)
We ___ go to the movies — maybe once a month. (40%)

ejercicios.texto_con_error: He plays always soccer on Sundays.
ejercicios.respuesta: He always plays soccer on Sundays.
She rarely goes shopping on Mondays.

ejercicios.instruccion: Turn it into a question with 'always'.
ejercicios.respuesta: Do you always do your homework?

ejercicios.pregunta: How often do you eat vegetables? (Answer with a full sentence and an adverb.)

guion: Sofía: Do you exercise a lot, Ben?
Ben: Yes! I always ride my bike to work.
Sofía: And do you go to the gym?
Ben: I sometimes go on Saturdays. And you?
Sofía: I often go swimming. I never stay in bed late!
Ben: Wow. I rarely wake up before seven on weekends.

comprension.pregunta: How often does Ben ride his bike to work?

reading.texto: My friends and I have very different habits. Ben always rides his bike to work, and he is never late. Kenji usually plays video games after school, but he sometimes does his homework first. Sofía often goes swimming on Saturdays, and she rarely eats out. Abuela Carmen always eats vegetables and never stays up late. She is the healthiest person I know.

preguntas.afirmacion: Kenji always does his homework first.
